Senior ML Platform Engineer, LLM Infrastructure
Lumenfield Analytics · Remote (United States) · Full-time

Posted 4 days ago · Req ID: ENG-2291

About Lumenfield
Lumenfield builds decision-intelligence software for mid-market insurers. More than 140 carriers use our platform to price risk, triage claims and detect fraud. We are a Series C company (raised $85M in 2025, led by Northbridge Ventures) with 310 employees, and our ML organization has grown from 6 to 28 people in the last two years. Over the last year we moved from classical models to a hybrid stack where LLM-based agents summarize claim files, draft adjuster notes and route edge cases to humans.

The team
You will join the ML Platform team (7 engineers) inside ML Engineering. The team owns the shared infrastructure every model team builds on: training pipelines, the model registry, the feature store, online inference, and — since this year — the LLM gateway, evaluation harness and observability stack. You will report to Priya Raman, Director of ML Platform.

What you will do
- Own the LLM gateway that fronts every model call in production (routing, retries, rate limiting, caching, cost attribution per product team).
- Build the offline and online evaluation system for our LLM features: golden sets, regression gates in CI, LLM-as-judge pipelines with human calibration, and drift monitoring on live traffic.
- Extend our observability stack (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, a warehouse-backed trace store) so product teams can debug an agent run end to end.
- Harden the path from notebook to production: model packaging, canary releases, automated rollback when online metrics regress.
- Partner with the Claims and Fraud model teams to take two new agentic workflows from prototype to 99.9% availability.
- Mentor two mid-level engineers and set technical direction for the platform's reliability roadmap.

What you bring
- 5+ years building production ML or data infrastructure, including at least 2 years owning shared platform components used by multiple teams.
- Strong Python; working knowledge of Go or another systems language.
- Hands-on experience with model serving and MLOps tooling (e.g. SageMaker, Kubeflow, MLflow, Ray Serve, or similar).
- Experience operating Kubernetes-based services with real SLOs, on-call and incident reviews.
- Practical experience evaluating LLM systems: building test sets, choosing metrics, catching regressions before they ship.
- Clear written communication; you write design docs other teams can act on.

Nice to have
- Streaming systems (Kafka, Flink) and real-time feature computation.
- Experience in a regulated industry (insurance, lending, healthcare).
- Open-source contributions in the ML tooling space.

Compensation and benefits
The base salary range for this role is $190,000–$230,000 USD, plus equity. Final offers depend on level and experience. Benefits include medical, dental and vision coverage (100% of premiums covered for employees), a 401(k) with 4% match, 20 days of PTO plus company holidays, a $1,500 annual learning budget, and a home-office stipend.

How we hire
1) 30-minute recruiter call. 2) 60-minute technical conversation with the hiring manager. 3) Take-home design exercise (paid, capped at 3 hours) or a live system-design session — your choice. 4) Virtual onsite: platform architecture, coding in Python, and a values interview. We aim to make decisions within 10 business days of the onsite.

Lumenfield is an equal opportunity employer. We do not use automated tools to make hiring decisions; every application is reviewed by a person. This role is open to candidates authorized to work in the United States; we are unable to sponsor visas for this position.
